composition: ServiceOutput is a concrete bounded queue of typed configuration writes, protocol result signals, and graphics effects. The actual controller consumes these through its owned settings/result/graphics providers. It is not a CPU callback boundary. NetworkSelftest consumes canonical LAN sockets; parent pumps LAN and radio.
